answer_1.quote: The ELI5 task asks models to generate paragraph-length answers to open-ended questions in English ...
answer_1.outputs: Paragraph-length answers generated for open‑ended questions

answer_2.quote: Answer quality is measured by the maximum overlap of generations with a set of gold answers in terms of unigram F1 score and ROUGE-L ...

answer_4.quote: We performed additional human A/B testing ... we ask human volunteers to choose between answers generated by the two systems ... In every test, participants were shown a question along with two answers (generated by different systems) presented in a random order. They were then asked to choose which generation (1) answered the question better / which answer was more relevant to the question; (2) was more coherent / had less repetition; (3) was more factually correct.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were shown a question and two answers and asked to select which answer was more relevant, more coherent, and more factually correct (with relevance prioritized).
